response.incident_summary: Between 11:50:09 and 11:50:12 UTC on 2026-06-29, the checkout-service (checkout-api-7c9d pod, namespace checkout, cluster demo-cluster, CNCC UUID cncc-demo-12345) experienced a sharp increase in HTTP 503 errors and payment dependency failures. The CheckoutHighErrorRate alert (ev_alert_001) was triggered at 11:50:10. Repeated log templates show a payment dependency becoming unavailable after retries (ev_log_template_003) and failed checkout requests (ev_log_template_002). Corresponding metric anomalies include a 1000% rise in payment_dependency_failures_total (ev_metric_006), a 1000% rise in http_request_errors_total (ev_metric_002) and request_error_rate (ev_metric_003), and a 1536% spike in p95 latency (ev_metric_004). One log line (ev_log_template_004) indicates a failure mode was enabled. All evidence links to the same set of entities.

primary_hypothesis.claim: The checkout errors and latency spikes are most likely caused by a failure in the payment dependency, which became unavailable and caused repeated retries and 503 responses.

domain_reasoning.fault_events: The CheckoutHighErrorRate alert (ev_alert_001) defines the incident trigger and explicitly mentions synthetic payment dependency failure causing HTTP 503 responses.
domain_reasoning.log_text: The most relevant log template (ev_log_template_003) directly reports payment dependency unavailability after retries, appearing 40 times (28.4% of logs) during the spike.
